# Reference transverse Mercator values for the UTM tests (tests/geo_coordinates_tests.cpp).
# Source: C. F. F. Karney, Test data for the transverse Mercator projection, 2009, Zenodo
# doi:10.5281/zenodo.32470 (file TMcoords.dat, MD5 91b817eae34aef3cd8d67b5a4e8e798f, CC0 1.0).
# Karney 2011, Transverse Mercator with an accuracy of a few nanometers, J. Geodesy 85(8) 475-485.
# Columns: latitude (deg), longitude from the central meridian (deg), easting and northing (m)
# on the central meridian scale 0.9996 with no false origin, meridian convergence (deg, positive
# east of the central meridian in the north), scale. The dataset has no point within 3 degrees of
# the central meridian in the south, so these rows are northern. The tests take one row per 4
# degree latitude band with the largest |longitude| (up to 3 degrees), three rows on the central
# meridian and one near the equator. Southern cases are derived in the test by mirroring the
# latitude, as UTM defines the southern grid. Values are kept at full precision.
